toolResult.reason:
Wrote design.md, spec.md, and tasks.md under specrunner/changes/detached-run-lifecycle/ on branch feat/detached-run-lifecycle-a250ec69.

design.md (D1–D8): CLI-internal self-respawn detach (child_process detached:true + unref + parent exit 0), env marker SPECRUNNER_DETACHED for recursion prevention, slug-keyed detach log under .specrunner/logs/ surfaced by job show, spawnBackground extension (detached/log-redirect/full-env passthrough with existing callers unchanged), parent/child slug parity, job wait as a process-death gate (pid liveness via state.pid → sidecar → isStaleRunning fallback, absorbing resume disk-lag), settle report + exit-code contract (awaiting-archive/archived→0, awaiting-resume/failed/terminated/canceled→1, arg/slug-absent→2), knowledge injection on the output surface (stderr foreground notice via logInfo, detach guidance, help) leaving foreground stdout/exit unchanged. Risks/Non-Goals cover PID reuse, secret passthrough scoping, log retention, and Windows/foreground-default exclusions.

spec.md: MUST-level requirements with Given/When/Then scenarios including the two required 破壊確認 scenarios (detach spawn shape, wait process-death gate).

tasks.md: T-01..T-12 ordered, each with acceptance criteria, mapping all request acceptance items (spawn contract + destructive check, detach parent, recursion prevention, wait gate + destructive check, exit codes, pid-absent fallback, slug-absent exit 2, output-contract text, foreground-unchanged, spawnBackground backward-compat, typecheck && test green). PLAN only — no src/docs edits performed.
